jobs.title: Staff Social Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



Summary: You'll own ClickUp's social strategy and build the systems to execute it at scale. You deeply understand what wins on each platform: the formats, the hooks, the timing, the tone. But you're not just a strategist who hands off a plan. You build AI-powered workflows and automation to operationalize your strategy so it runs continuously, learns from data, and scales beyond what any team could do manually. You're a social-native operator who builds systems, not an engineer who dabbles in social.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Own platform-native social strategy across X, LinkedIn, TikTok, and emerging channels: define what ClickUp's voice, format, and engagement approach looks like on each, tailored to what works on that platform

 - Develop and execute content and engagement strategies that drive measurable growth in reach, engagement, and audience quality

 - Identify trends, conversations, and cultural moments worth engaging with, and move fast enough to capitalize on them

 - Build AI-powered systems and automated workflows to execute social strategy at scale: monitoring, engagement, response, and content distribution

 - Create feedback loops between social performance data and strategy; use signal to iterate what gets made and how it gets distributed

 - Own proactive engagement: identify and engage relevant conversations, mentions, and opportunities using AI-powered monitoring and automated response workflows

 - Develop automated systems that handle routine engagement while escalating high-value or brand-sensitive conversations to humans

 - Own execution end-to-end: strategy through measurement, with clear accountability for outcomes

 - Partner with content creators, influencer team, and brand to ensure systems amplify their work

 - Establish and report on social growth KPIs with clear attribution

 

Requirements:

 - 5-7+ years in social media strategy with demonstrated expertise in platform-native content and engagement strategy (you know what works on X vs. LinkedIn vs. TikTok and why)

 - Proven track record of growing social presence with strategic intent: not just posting more, but understanding the mechanics of each platform and exploiting them

 - Strong creative taste and editorial instinct for what resonates on social: you can look at a piece of content and know whether it'll hit before it goes live

 - 2+ years building AI-powered systems and automated workflows to scale social execution (monitoring, engagement, response, distribution). Using ChatGPT to draft captions is not sufficient.

 - Technical fluency: comfortable with APIs, automation platforms (Zapier, Make, custom), and can deploy integrations between systems without an engineer

 - Strong strategic thinker who takes things from 0 to 1 independently: vision to execution, measurable outcomes, zero hand-holding

 - Data-obsessed: builds dashboards, runs experiments, iterates based on signal not gut

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



About the Role

ClickUp is looking for an FP&A Manager to serve as the financial business partner across three functions: R&D, G&A, and Corporate. You'll own the full cycle of forecasting, month-end close, and budget vs. actuals reporting for each, partnering directly with department leaders and the accounting team. This is a high-autonomy role on a lean Strategic Finance team where you'll have real ownership from day one.

 

What You'll Do

 - R&D: Own expense management, vendor and invoice approvals, headcount planning, non-headcount forecasting, cloud infrastructure cost tracking, and month-end variance analysis and leadership reporting.

 - G&A: Drive expense forecasting, headcount planning, vendor approvals, and month-end close activities including variance analysis and BvA reporting for G&A departments.

 - Corporate: Prepare board of directors, QFR, and investor-ready reporting decks. Manage billings actualization and forecasting, and deliver monthly finance readouts to executive leadership.

 - Partner with Accounting through the monthly close cycle, including soft close, hard close, and results review with budget owners.

 - Maintain rolling forecasts, provide variance commentary for material deviations, and lock forecasts on a monthly cadence.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with recruiting, procurement, and department leaders on headcount and spend decisions.

 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate forecasting workflows, variance commentary, and ad-hoc analysis, setting the bar for AI-augmented FP&A on the team.

 

What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years of FP&A or strategic finance experience, ideally in a high-growth SaaS/tech environment.

 - Experience owning multiple cost centers or business lines simultaneously.

 - Fluency in SaaS financial metrics (ARR, NRR, gross margin, CAC, CLTV) and the ability to connect operating metrics to financial outcomes.

 - Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and budget-to-actual analysis skills.

 - Comfort with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan, or similar), ERP systems (NetSuite preferred), and procurement platforms (Coupa or equivalent).

 - Experience preparing materials for board, executive, and investor audiences, distilling complex data into clear, actionable narratives.

 - Ability to operate independently across multiple stakeholder groups with minimal direction.

 - Strong business partnering instincts: you make department heads sharper, not slower.

 

Nice to Have

 - Prior experience in a high-growth, pre-IPO environment.

 - Genuine AI fluency: you actively use AI tools to accelerate modeling, analysis, and communication in your daily work.

 - Familiarity with AWS/cloud cost tracking and COGS reporting.

 - Experience with HRIS/ATS systems (Workday, Ashby, Greenhouse) for headcount management.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



Summary: You own the path from a new signup to a deeply engaged, paid workspace that runs on ClickUp and Brain². You build the self-serve onboarding and lifecycle systems (in-app and email) that meet users where they are, generate the right content at the right time based on their actual activity, and guide them into deeper product usage. You own conversion to paid: how paywalls appear and perform, when and how promos run, and what ultimately gets a workspace to upgrade. Your north star is driving users to realize the value of an AI-enabled ClickUp workspace. You think in systems, not campaigns. You use AI as your force multiplier to operate at a scale that would normally require a team.

 

This is not an enterprise customer nurturing role.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Self-Serve Onboarding & Lifecycle:

 - Own the end-to-end self-serve onboarding experience: in-app flows, lifecycle emails, and product surface messaging that take a new signup from first session to deeply engaged workspace.

 - Build trigger-based systems that respond to user activity in real time. A user who just created their first list gets different guidance than one who just invited their team. Every touchpoint is personalized based on what the user has actually done and what would be most useful to them next.

 - Use AI to generate contextual content for users at the right moment: workspace templates, suggested workflows, feature education, and use-case-specific guidance, all driven by what they're actually doing in ClickUp.

 - Master the timing, placement, and frequency of in-app and email interventions. Run rapid experiments to learn what drives deeper usage and what causes friction or fatigue.

 

Conversion to Paid:

 - Own how free workspaces convert to paid plans. That means paywall design and copy, pricing page optimization, promo strategy, and understanding exactly which moments and behaviors make a workspace ready to buy.

 - Design and run conversion experiments at 3-5x the velocity of a traditional marketer because you've built AI systems that handle the volume, not because you grind harder.

 - Know which activation behaviors predict conversion and architect the onboarding experience to produce more of them.

 

Driving Brain² Adoption:

 - You are the person who gets users to go deep with Brain² and get real value from it as quickly as possible after signup.

 - Build the systems that surface Brain² at the right moment in a user's journey: when they're doing something manually that AI could do, when they're stuck, when they'd benefit from AI-generated content or automation.

 - Own the metrics that prove users are getting value from AI-enabled workspaces and use those metrics to feed back into the onboarding and lifecycle systems.

 

Requirements:

 - 7-10+ years in product/growth marketing with deep ownership of post-signup user journeys: onboarding, activation, conversion, and retention in self-serve SaaS

 - Built lifecycle and in-app messaging systems from scratch inside a complex, multi-surface product (not a single-flow app) — can walk through how they navigated product depth without overwhelming new users

 - Deep experience with conversion optimization: paywalls, pricing, promo strategy, and the experimentation that makes them work

 - Data fluent: cohort analysis, activation metrics, conversion funnels, and behavioral segmentation

 - Already operates at 3-5x output through AI-powered systems

 

How We'll Evaluate You:

 - Show us a lifecycle or onboarding system you built end-to-end, with before/after numbers on activation or conversion. We want to know a bit about how you'd build this.

 - Be a power user of a work management or productivity platform. We'll give you a real activation problem and you'll show us how you'd fix it.

 - Walk us through how you'd take a user from "just signed up" to "deep in ClickUp, paying, and actively using Brain²."

Summary: You're the single point of excellence for ClickUp's visual brand. You set the standard and ensure every touchpoint (from landing pages to social to product marketing assets) feels cohesive and world-class. But here's what makes this different: you're building a design system that AI tools and non-designers can produce bar-raising creatives on their own with your infrastructure. You build the guardrails that make everyone else excellent and ensure the company is never bottlenecked by design.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Own, maintain, and evolve ClickUp's brand design system (tokens, components, patterns, guidelines), continuously elevating the aesthetic bar as the brand grows

 - Serve as quality gatekeeper: review and approve brand-facing creative produced by AI tools, vibe-coded outputs, and external agencies

 - Create and maintain design system documentation, templates, component libraries, and automation-friendly asset packages that enable others to produce on-brand work without design support

 - Design and ship high-volume web assets (landing pages, campaign pages, feature announcements) alongside high-impact brand moments like launches and keynotes

 - Audit and rebuild the brand design system from incomplete foundations, establishing documentation and structure where little currently exists

 

Requirements:

 - 8+ years of brand/visual design experience, with significant time owning or leading a design system

 - Exceptional portfolio demonstrating mastery of typography, layout, color, motion, and systematic thinking

 - Actively uses AI design tools (Midjourney, Firefly, Claude Design, Figma AI, etc.) and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) in their current workflow, with light familiarity with GitHub.

 - Has built or adapted design systems specifically to enable high-quality AI-generated outputs at scale.

 - Experience building design systems used at scale, including templates, component libraries, and constraints that enable non-designers and AI tools to produce on-brand output consistently

jobs.title: Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success (AMER)
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



We're looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success to act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to our customers, blending strong relationship management with a deep understanding of ClickUp’s platform and capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of customer success, solution strategy, and technical enablement, supporting long-term growth, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 

Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success at ClickUp lead with a customer-first mindset, developing success plans, guiding onboarding and adoption, and ensuring stakeholders see continuous value throughout their lifecycle. While you’ll support technical initiatives like process optimization, workflow design, and AI enablement, you’ll also own the overall health, engagement, and strategic direction of your accounts. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Support to align efforts and ensure each customer’s success story is long-term, scalable, and impactful.

 

Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success at ClickUp are responsible for delivering measurable value and driving meaningful business outcomes across their customer portfolio by focusing on:

 - Customer Enablement & Onboarding: Guiding new teams through implementation, onboarding, and training to ensure a smooth start and foundational success.

 - Account Health & Engagement: Proactively managing user adoption, stakeholder alignment, and account health to promote long-term success, retention, and growth opportunities.

 - Process Optimization & Solution Design: Collaborating with customers to identify critical business processes, map them to scalable solutions, and drive efficiency through ongoing refinement and performance insights.

 - Innovation Adoption & Workflow Automation: Empowering customers to leverage emerging features and technologies, including AI and automation, to enhance productivity, streamline operations, and deliver real-world impact.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success at ClickUp act as the strategic and technical owner of the customer relationship, ensuring every customer achieves measurable success through ClickUp product and AI feature set.

 

 - New Customer Onboarding 
   
   - Lead or support the end-to-end onboarding and implementation of ClickUp, from discovery and solution design to training and go-live support.
   
   - Translate functional and technical requirements into scalable ClickUp solutions, including workflows, templates, hierarchies, and automations.
   
   - Guide customers through foundational setup, integration, and enablement, while promoting best-practices and system governance and change management.

 - Account Health Management
   
   - Monitor seat utilization, adoption trends, and Champion/Stakeholder engagement.
   
   - Build and execute adoption plans and account reviews to maintain or improve health.
   
   - Identify risks early and build recovery plans in partnership with the account team.
   
   - Deliver ongoing change management and enablement, ensuring customers continue to evolve and mature with the platform.

 - Workflow Mapping (IER Framework)
   
   - Conduct Intake → Execution → Reporting (IER) cycles for key workflows.
   
   - Lead discovery sessions to map current-state vs. future-state processes.
   
   - Recommend optimizations and create workflow templates to scale across teams.

 - AI Enablement & Agent Deployment
   
   - Drive adoption of ClickUp AI and build custom workflow Agents tied to customer use cases.
   
   - Partner with customers to define and deliver new AI automations that align with business KPIs.
   
   - Provide technical training and consultation on AI and automation best practices, including prompt design, agent architecture, and scaling use cases across teams.
   
   - Track and report AI usage and credit consumption against plan.

 - Customer Success & Expansion
   
   - Serve as the technical partner to assigned accounts, connecting adoption to business value.
   
   - Generate qualified leads through data-driven insights and AI usage analysis.
   
   - Drive cross-functional alignment to position renewals, expansions, and AI upsells.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
   
   - Act as the voice of the customer, translating business objectives and pain points into actionable insights for Product, Engineering, and Support.
   
   - Partner with account teams to maintain alignment between delivery and success.

 


CORE SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

 - Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of ClickUp platform capabilities, automation logic, integrations, and AI Agent functionality. Able to translate business needs into technical solutions.

 - AI Expertise: Familiar with generative AI concepts, prompt design, and automation frameworks. Skilled at identifying and scoping AI use cases and consumption plans.

 - Consultative Discovery: Exceptional at workflow analysis, process design, and identifying friction points. Uses structured discovery to map customer needs into ClickUp.

 - Project and Program Management: Ability to manage complex customer programs with multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and outcomes. Skilled at running structured account plans.

 - Data and Reporting: Comfortable using dashboards and metrics to communicate health, adoption, and ROI. Interprets usage data to drive recommendations.

 - Customer Engagement: Executive presence and strong communication skills. Builds trust at both ATL and BTL levels through credibility and clarity.

 - Account Ownership: Full accountability for assigned book of business: proactive, organized, and driven to achieve measurable outcomes.

 - Collaboration and Influence: Works cross-functionally with account team, Product, and Sales to align on outcomes. Influences without authority through insight and results.

jobs.title: CX Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



As a CX Operations Analyst, you will own key operational processes related to Partner Services (SOWs, invoicing, renewal processes, system access) while also providing data analysis, workflow automation, and AI builds that support multiple functions including TAM, Solutions and Support/CX. You are the person who keeps critical operational machinery running smoothly while continuously improving how it works.

 

This role works across the full CX Ops team and partners with stakeholders in TAM, Solutions, Support, Partner Services, Finance, and GTM Systems. You'll collaborate closely with other CX Ops team members on initiatives while taking direct ownership of your assigned processes and analytical deliverables. The right person for this role is detail-oriented, analytically strong, and energized by building automations and AI solutions that eliminate manual work. This role connects directly to our mission of making every CX team faster, better-informed, and more consistent through operational excellence. If you are an AI native, proactive, data-driven individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you!

 
 


ABOUT THE ROLE


PROFESSIONAL SERVICES OPERATIONS

 - Operationalize partner delivery quality and customer outcomes measurement to ensure accountability regardless of delivery model

 - Support the end-to-end SOW management process for Partner subcontracting: creation, tracking, amendments, and closure in coordination with Partner Services leadership and Finance

 - Execute partner invoicing workflows: validate submissions, process approvals, track payments, and resolve discrepancies

 - Enable partner system access: provisioning, de-provisioning, and ongoing governance of partner access to internal tools and customer environments

 - Support capacity planning and resource assignments as the business scales

 - Maintain accurate records and documentation for all partner operational processes, ensuring audit readiness and clear escalation paths

 


WORKFLOW AUTOMATION & AI BUILDS

 - Build, ship, and iterate on AI-driven workflows that enhance and automate internal processes, customer health inspection, risk detection, engagement management, services delivery lifecycle, quality measurement, and customer experience across TAM, Solutions and CX

 - Develop AI agents and AI-assisted tools in collaboration with team members, contributing to the team's broader automation roadmap

 - Actively leverage AI in daily work: data analysis and modeling, stakeholder communications, problem-solving and workflow orchestration

 - Facilitate the adoption of new tools and processes, including AI and automation platforms, to drive productivity across the organization

 - Apply strong judgment to validate AI outputs, manage risk, and improve the repeatable systems the team uses

 - Stay current with AI developments relevant to CX operations and translate learnings into solution improvements

 


DATA INSIGHTS

 - Extract key business insights from qualitative and quantitative data, identify risks and opportunities, and inform programs that drive revenue retention, expansion, quality, and operating leverage

 - Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Salesforce, ClickUp and Hex that support TAM, Solutions, and Partner Services leadership with operational visibility

 - Perform ad hoc data analysis to answer business questions, surface trends, and support decision-making by CX Ops team members and stakeholders

 - Support renewals and retention analysis with data extraction, formatting, and pattern identification

 


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMS

 - Own specific deliverables within larger strategic initiatives to optimize and transform customer engagement, services delivery, and internal collaboration processes

 - Support senior CX Ops team members on projects spanning TAM, Solutions, and Partner functions, executing assigned works with high quality and reliability

 - Respond to ad hoc operational requests from CX Ops leadership and stakeholders with timely, accurate deliverables

 - Embody a culture of rapid innovation and experimentation across playbooks to drive customer outcomes and enhanced experience

 


ABOUT YOU

 - 3+ years in Operations, Analytics, or a related role, preferably in a SaaS, customer-facing, or GTM environment

 - Demonstrated track record of building and deploying AI-powered workflows that delivered productivity gains, better decision quality, cleaner execution, improved data signals, or increased customer reach

 - Track record of supporting technology-enabled business process transformations, with an emphasis on strategic application of AI and agentic solutions

 - Proficient in managing and analyzing data, including building reports and scenario analysis models, as well as leveraging business intelligence tools to drive leadership strategy

 - Effective at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across global regions, reaching consensus, and driving change together

 - Proficient with Salesforce, Gong, ClickUp, Hex, Tableau, Google Apps Script and comparable platforms

 - Direct experience with a SaaS business model, customer journey, and core KPIs in a high-growth, global environment

 - Knowledge of professional services and customer success methodology, processes, tools, and metrics

 - Strategic thinker with a bias for action - hands-on, scrappy, and able to take projects to the finish line
